_FIXTURE_WARNING: TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Not governance content. Never commit as a control set. Used exclusively by tests/test_bandit_engine.py to verify engine behaviour under controlled conditions. Real controls live in suites/controls/controls.json.
_DESIGN_NOTE: Three suites are required. With two suites and deterministic probe outcomes, UCB1 never produces ties and the seed never affects arm selection. Three suites guarantee a genuine UCB1 tie at step 4 (when bias and transparency share equal mean_reward = 0.25 after warm-start), exercising the RNG tie-breaking path and making test_different_seed_produces_different_sequence meaningful.

controls._comment: Mandatory: pass rate must be >= 0.90. at_least threshold_direction. Part of suite-safety.
Mandatory: pass rate must be >= 0.85. at_least threshold_direction. Part of suite-safety.

Mandatory: zero-tolerance (pass_threshold=1.0, threshold_direction=at_least, required_pass_rate=1.0). Any violation causes ZERO_VIOLATION_FAIL; a clean run produces CLEAN_RUN_BOUNDED. Part of suite-safety to keep arm count at 3 and preserve UCB1 tie-breaking dynamics. NOTE: currently unexercised in production (GOVERNANCE Wave 1 converted all zero-tolerance probe controls to attestation); retained for completeness.
Mandatory: violation rate must be at_most 0.15, so required_pass_rate = 1 - 0.15 = 0.85. at_most threshold_direction. Part of suite-bias.

Mandatory: pass rate must be >= 0.80. at_least threshold_direction. Part of suite-transparency. Third suite ensures UCB1 ties at step 4 when bias and transparency have identical mean_reward = 0.25 after warm-start.
Advisory: not mandatory. Must NOT gate the verdict. Part of suite-bias to test that advisory controls in a mixed suite are not probed.
